title: Gudea of Sumer given temple plans in a dream

tellings.quote: King Judaea of Sumeria saying that in a dream he was given this lapis lazuli,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to an ancient text about Gudea, a king of Sumer, one of the earliest civilisations in what is now Iraq. Michels says Gudea wrote that in a dream he was given something made of lapis lazuli, a deep blue stone, tied to the plans for a temple, and he mentions other ancient rulers, Thutmose and Nebuchadnezzar, in the same breath. He tells it as a hint that ancient builders may have received their designs from some outside source.
